float_pointer_borrow.underlying_views: Original ISA operations with concrete scalar ghosts; active fields structurally equal to the same existing Coq operation, arbitrary typed inactive fields. Human ISA/ABI review pending.
float_pointer_borrow.scope: C-shim pointer/copy representation only; no physical SIMD ABI or ISA refinement theorem claimed

record_views.record_layout: Canonical Char/Short/Int/fp32-Float scalar fields under explicit Snaive_C_Rules64. Generated default Arch32BE and floatR/Int definitions rejected; goal bytes unchanged. Physical SIMD ABI correspondence remains unproved and human-reviewed boundary.
record_views.active_contracts: All legal0<=VL<=32, all typed input/tail values and all binary32 scale. Output only constrains requested active lanes; no zero-tail guarantee. Reinterpret is exact all32 same-width bits with arbitrary input tail.
record_views.ordinary_helper_input_alias: The compute adapter borrows two distinct local vector objects va/vb. Global input A/B remain represented by one RDMap and may overlap partially or completely. No new public A!=B premise.
record_views.operation_order: Two signed16 wrap subtracts, signed widening multiply, int32-to-fp32 RNE, separate multiply/add, bit-classified NaN Scale sign restore, reinterpret, signed32 saturating subtract, shift0 signed16/signed8 clips, maxLo then minHi. No fused replacement or bounds ordering premise.
record_views.native_compatibility_before_after: proof/repair.json record_loop_compatibility; finite before/after output comparison plus independent scalar oracle is separate from formal repaired-main proof.
